notes.title: The Rekindled Update 🔥 Now Available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Ki19S03GnjI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]A [i]free[/i] update to the original base game, 🔥Rekindled features:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Visual Improvements[/b] 
Over 50% of the art has been reworked for improved clarity

[*] [b]Gameplay & Interface Enhancements[/b]
Plus a brand new Cabin Menu experience

[*] [b]Additional Characters[/b]
Now choose from 6 backpackers, plus a secret one to discover

[*] [b]Performance Improvements[/b]
Procedurally generated biomes are now more performant

[*] [b]Revamped Controller Support[/b]
Simply plug & play with your controller at any point in the game

[*] [b]Bugfixes & More![/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7977506/1574ed7a3b20e41f3c818bf93c15e03078e2f756.gif[/img]



[h2][b]Note from the Team[/b][/h2]

We're excited to get the Rekindled Update out to you all, it's been a long time coming. Thank you to all the original fans for your support over the years and a warm welcome to any newcomers. We hope you all enjoy the update!

- Kyle & the Beach Interactive Team



[h2][b]Frequently Asked Questions[/b][/h2]

[b]Will the Rekindled Update include new gameplay features or mechanics (new animals, items, biomes, multiplayer, etc.)? [/b]

The Rekindled Update is a refinement of the original game and its features. Improvements have been made across the board to existing features, but we will not be introducing brand new animals, items or biomes in this update. 


[b]Will you ever add new gameplay features or mechanics to [i]On My Own[/i]? [/b]

We [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LfI6sRtb5R4]recently announced[/url] that we are looking into expanding [i]On My Own[/i] after the Rekindled Update. Nothing is official, but the team is looking into the logistics of another update. Please consider joining us on Discord or one of our social media accounts to stay up to date.



[h2][b]Join us on Discord![/b][/h2]

Hang out with the development team and other [i]On My Own[/i] fans on our Discord Server by joining our [url=http://beach-interactive.com/#email-signup]email club here[/url]. You'll also get news updates and exclusive content. You can unsubscribe from the list [i]anytime[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7977506/8b631a78a4e314938bacae45d684c840bbd33e3d.png[/img]



[h3]Don't have [i]On My Own[/i] yet? Add it to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] today![/h3]

notes.title: January Update - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We have some good news today: we released our first update since this summer that will hopefully fix some issues that players are having. 

This update includes (but is not limited to):
[list]
[*]Controller set-up bug has been fixed. We recommend trying out OMO with a controller for a more relaxing experience.

[*]Fire bow drill is now easier to use. Try crafting this item when you run out of matches.

[*]Computers that are having issues with UI resolution should see an increase in UI fidelity.
[/list]
[b]Thanks to our new developer Alex for looking into these bugs. We hope to continue looking into issues based on user feedback. Thanks for your support![/b]

notes.title: May Update (Controller Support!)
notes.content:
It's been some time, but we are back with an update for On My Own! 

- Players will finally be to sit back and enjoy the game with a controller as we are bringing gamepad support in this update. 

- We've also been listening to user feedback, and added a couple new prompts in the game. When choosing to travel to a new biome, it's now more explicit that players will need both food and energy to make the trek. Also, there is a new prompt warning players when they are getting close to starving. 

Let us know if you have any questions or concerns. Thanks, hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: January News Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, wanted to share a news update on how development is going, and what we have left to do!
[list]
[*]All planned gameplay features are now complete!

[*]Soundtrack is finished, now focusing on adding sound effects

[*]Working to balance all the gameplay elements, and polishing visuals

[*]Revamping tutorial, and journal; crafting recipes will now be included for items you've already made

[*]Finishing story elements; story will hint at how to craft complex items
[/list]
 
[b]We look forward to sharing a big announcement with you very soon![/b] Until then, thank you for your support. Please let us know if you have any questions.

notes.title: December News Update
notes.content:
News update on development progress! We hit some big milestones these past few weeks:
[list]
[*]All 4 biomes with all 4 seasons are finished

[*]New seasonal interface is completed

[*]All the art and game animations are completed

[*]The final song for the game is in review, then the soundtrack is finished
[/list]
[B]We are very close to having all the features that we initially pitched when we launched this game on Early Access finished.[/B]

Once we get these last features polished up, we'll post the final trailer and a release date. We appreciate everyones patience as we continue to make progress on the game!

notes.title: News Update
notes.content:
We've been very quiet since our last update in early October, but the team has been working very hard on what we are hoping is the final release version of [i]On My Own[/i]. We apologize about the lack of communication; know that the team is fully committed to seeing this project through to completion. 

Here is some of the new content and features that players can look forward to, along with some new screenshots of the final biome:

https://www.facebook.com/OnMyOwn.Game/photos/pcb.977210452345730/977209619012480/?type=3&theater

https://www.facebook.com/OnMyOwn.Game/photos/pcb.977210452345730/977209612345814/?type=3&theater

[*][b]The Mountain Biome will be available for players to check out[/b]. This biome will be the most unique of the 4, as players will need to be well prepared to overcome the harsh elements in order to reach the top of the mountain.

[*][b]Each biome will now have all four seasons, Summer, Fall, Winter and Spring.[/b] Each season will offer a unique challenge in what resources will be available. Players will be able to keep track of the length of each season with a new seasonal interface element during the nightly sleep screen.

[*][b]Players can discover secret letters and items left behind by the mysterious forebear.[/b]

[*][b]New craftable items and wearables to help on your journey.[/b] Also, the Journal Menu will now show crafting recipes of items that you have made.

[*][b]New level of visual polish, with some refined animations, more detailed background assets, and new lighting features.[/b]

[*][b]New original music for players to enjoy.[/b]

[*][b]Gameplay adjustments to help usability across all platforms.[/b] We've been listening to user feedback, and continue to refine the gameplay experience.

[*][b]A more cohesive tutorial, with hints to help get players up to speed on the gameplay.[/b]

[*][b]And some secret stuff that you'll just have to find in the game![/b]

We hope to have a final game trailer and release date for you in the coming weeks. Thank you for your support on this project, and please feel free to share your thoughts and feedback, we'd love to hear it!

notes.title: Update 0.5 is Live!
notes.content:
The newest update for On My Own is now available on Steam Early Access!  We created a Update Video to explain the new features: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=szOrmt26MAA 


This update includes (but is not limited to): 

-Menu overhaul. Revamped all of the menus to be consistent across the game.

-New female avatar sneak peek

-New title song and forest song

-Multiple saves (Note all past saves will not be compatible with the new version. We are sorry for the inconvenience, but we are in Beta!)

-Status indicators. Indicators include things like cold, sleeping, weight, etc.

-Big performance update.  We optimized the code so the game runs much faster and can handle the load of bigger maps without bogging down systems.

-New tutorial images and sleeping screen.  Gives you hints and tips on how to play the game.

-New winter map screen

-New loading screen quote

-New tutorial images and sleeping screen.  Gives you hints and tips on how to play the game.

notes.title: Update 0.3 Is Live!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that our biggest update for On My Own is now available on Steam Early Access! This update includes (but is not limited to):

- A new camp, the Alpine Tundra Biome, complete with new flora and fauna to discover. 

- New User Interface implementation that labels all objects for the player.

- Journal Encyclopedia that documents all items, plants, and creatures in the game. Accessed from the Main Menu.

- Food Cache in the Woodland Lake Biome to expand the amount of items you can store.

- New craftable Deerskin Jacket to keep you warm in the winters and help conserve energy.

- A brand new song, written specifically for the new Alpine Tundra Biome.

- Performance Improvement including a new spawning system

- New craftable Deerskin Jacket to keep you warm in the winters and help conserve energy.
- A brand new song, written specifically for the new Alpine Tundra Biome.
- Performance Improvement including a new spawning system

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 is live!
notes.content:
Update 1.0.5 is now released,  This release contains mostly bug fixes and optimizations.  The fixes include(not limited to):
- Not being able to get the Warmth Achievement
- Unlimited Fireweed
- Performing actions while changing equipped item
- Stuck on loading screen
-Most optimizations are from the new season system.  Seasons (Winter and Summer currently) now happen on a 5 day cycle.

We want to thank everyone for their early support, this was a great and insightful first week on Steam. We are busy working on new content and gameplay features for "On My Own", and are excited to share it with you as soon as we can. Thanks again!
